name: skill-trace
description: Side pane: per question, the skills Claude chose and why, plus the MCP tools, subagents, hooks and slash commands it used.

start.title: Open at start
start.description: on: the Skill Trace pane opens when a session starts. off: it stays closed until you run /skill-trace.

reason.title: Ask for reasons
reason.description: on: a reason tool (mcp__skill-trace__reason) is registered and Claude records { skill, reason } alongside each Skill call; the pane shows it. off: no tool or rule is added; skills show 'no reason given'.

cost.title: Track tokens and cost
cost.description: on: each question gets a Cost section with the model(s), the API-reported tokens and their list-price cost (Chat), plus the estimated share skill-trace added (rule, reason tool, reason calls). Works only while Ask for reasons is on; with reasons off it is off too. Prices are API list prices, not what a subscription bills.
